cohort: 92 pregnancies in 83 women with multiple sclerosis (MS) treated with natalizumab, compared to pregnancies in untreated patients and patients treated with injectable immunomodulatory agents.
finding: Natalizumab exposure up to 12 weeks of gestation was associated with an increased risk of SA, although within the range expected in the general population, and lower infant length and weight.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome, but no specific values provided.
